```python
import griffe
from griffe.diff import get_breaking_changes

# Load package at v1.0.0
old = griffe.load("mypkg", ref="v1.0.0")

# Load package at HEAD
new = griffe.load("mypkg", ref="HEAD")

# Detect and print breaking changes
for breakage in get_breaking_changes(old, new):
    print(breakage)
```
